jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead our core web app experience. You will collaborate with design and product teams to craft ultra-responsive, accessible, and delightful interactive interfaces using modern React.
requirements: 5+ years building complex web applications with React and TypeScript
Deep understanding of browser performance, rendering lifecycles, and modern CSS
Proven track record of delivering clean, well-tested user interfaces
Experience collaborating with Figma design systems and product managers
benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible work hours and unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Staff Backend Distributed Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Architect high-throughput microservices handling millions of events per second. You will design fault-tolerant data pipelines, distributed caches, and resilient APIs that power mission-critical infrastructure.
requirements: 7+ years experience in distributed backend architectures (Go, Node.js, or Java)
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, and Kubernetes
Hands-on expertise with system design, observability, and latency tuning
Excellent communication in an asynchronous remote-first team
benefits: 100% remote across US, Canada, and EU
Annual team retreats in Europe and Asia

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)
jobs.description: Shape the visual and interaction identity of our next-generation creative tools. You will lead design sprints, conduct user research, and maintain our multi-platform component library.
requirements: 6+ years designing B2B SaaS or consumer-facing mobile/web apps
Mastery of Figma, design tokens, interactive prototyping, and user journey mapping
Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and clean visual execution
Experience mentoring junior designers and aligning cross-functional stakeholders
benefits: Beautiful Manhattan loft office with catered lunches
Full medical, dental, and optical coverage

jobs.title: Data Analyst & Business Intelligence Lead
jobs.description: Turn raw transaction logs and user telemetry into actionable executive dashboards. Build automated reporting pipelines, evaluate product experiments, and discover revenue optimization opportunities.
requirements: 3+ years in data analytics, business intelligence, or financial modeling
Advanced SQL querying across Snowflake/BigQuery
Proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy) and BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker)
Strong statistical intuition for A/B testing evaluation

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (React & Node.js)
jobs.description: Join an agile team building telehealth portals and patient diagnostic workflows. You will write clean TypeScript across our frontend React client and Node.js REST/GraphQL services.
requirements: 3+ years full-stack JavaScript/TypeScript engineering experience
Solid hands-on background with React, Express/NestJS, and PostgreSQL
Experience building secure, HIPAA-compliant or sensitive data systems
Comfortable working with CI/CD and Docker environments

jobs.title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Specialist
jobs.description: Build automated infrastructure as code, enhance Kubernetes clusters, and scale our multi-region AWS footprint. Ensure 99.99% uptime with robust Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
requirements: 4+ years managing production cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
Deep expertise with Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE)
Strong scripting skills in Bash and Python or Go
Proven experience establishing GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD/GitHub Actions)

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Developer
jobs.description: Great opportunity for an enthusiastic frontend developer to grow with experienced mentors. You will convert design mockups into semantic, responsive HTML/CSS/React components.
requirements: 1-2 years experience or strong project portfolio with React and modern JavaScript
Solid grasp of responsive layouts, CSS Flexbox/Grid, and Tailwind CSS
Familiarity with Git, REST APIs, and debugging in browser DevTools
Eagerness to learn and take constructive feedback
benefits: Paid time off and company holidays

jobs.title: Mobile App Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description: 6-month contract with extension potential to build cross-platform mobile features for our iOS and Android on-demand delivery platform using React Native and Expo.
requirements: 3+ years experience developing cross-platform apps with React Native
Experience with native bridges, push notifications, and geolocation APIs
Published at least two production apps to Apple App Store or Google Play
Strong knowledge of state management and offline-first caching
benefits: Flexible working hours across all US time zones
Direct impact on 500k+ active mobile users

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Lead developer-facing API products and merchant checkout integration tools. Define product roadmaps, coordinate engineering sprints, and drive adoption metrics.
requirements: 4+ years product management experience in fintech, developer tools, or SaaS
Technical background (computer science degree or past software engineering experience)
Exceptional PRD writing and requirement definition skills
Strong customer empathy and data-driven prioritization skills
benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental wellness

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: Join our 12-week paid summer internship program! You will work alongside experienced software engineers on real production features, data pipelines, and internal tools.
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related STEM field
Familiarity with at least one programming language (Python, JavaScript, or Java)
Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and web basics
High curiosity and eagerness to build real-world software
benefits: Housing stipend or corporate housing assistance
Intern social events, hackathons, and tech talks
Direct conversion pathway to full-time new grad offer

jobs.title: UI Designer & Design Systems Specialist
jobs.description: Part-time (24 hours/week) design role focused on auditing, updating, and documenting our universal design token system and Figma UI kit.
requirements: 3+ years dedicated to UI design and scalable component architecture
Extensive experience with Figma variables, auto-layout, and tokens Studio
Understanding of WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards and contrast ratios
Familiarity with Tailwind CSS or CSS variables is a big plus
benefits: Flexible part-time schedule tailored to your availability

jobs.title: Machine Learning / AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Build production LLM application pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, and fine-tuning harnesses for enterprise clients.
requirements: 4+ years deploying applied machine learning models into customer-facing products
Proficiency with Python, PyTorch, LangChain/LlamaIndex, and Vector DBs (Pinecone/pgvector)
Experience building low-latency inference servers and evaluation benchmarks
Deep understanding of transformer architectures and prompt engineering
benefits: Competitive salary plus top-tier equity package
Unlimited conferences and research material budget

jobs.title: Quality Assurance & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Establish automated end-to-end testing suites using Playwright and Cypress. Help prevent regression bugs across complex multi-step user onboarding and financial transactions.
requirements: 3+ years in automated software testing for web applications
Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright, and Cypress
Experience integrating automated test runs into GitHub Actions pipelines
Sharp attention to detail and ability to write reproducible bug reports
benefits: Modern downtown Austin office with free parking

jobs.title: Security & Compliance Engineer
jobs.description: Maintain SOC2 Type II compliance, conduct security vulnerability assessments, and implement zero-trust access architecture across enterprise cloud workloads.
requirements: 5+ years in cloud security, vulnerability management, and infrastructure hardening
Knowledge of SOC2, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance frameworks
Hands-on experience with AWS IAM, CloudTrail, and security scanning tools
Experience conducting threat modeling and coordinating penetration tests
